Figure 3. CoCoDetect pipeline. Training stage processes real–fake video pairs: R3D-18 extracts features F, fed into dual heads producing confidence P (for authenticity classification) and contrastive embeddings Z (for paired contrastive loss). Inference stage uses threshold τ to route uncertain samples to MLLM, which outputs structured JSON {ŷ, p̂, reasoning}. The MLLM outputs are then fused with P via decision fusion to yield Pfinal for final classification.
Table 10. Robustness evaluation of CoCoDetect under different perturbations. All metrics are in percentage (%). Bold indicates the best performance.
